objective: Identify suitable therapeutic targets from the conditional variant-to-phenotype mechanism, then evaluate medicines that can produce the desired target intervention.
nomination_requirements: Identify the drug and an approved medicinal formulation.
Explain the causal chain, intervention direction and relevant model evidence.
Distinguish established mechanistic links from the proposed inference.
Describe the main competing explanation or condition that changes the prediction.
ranking_policy: Prioritize target hypotheses by variant mechanism, phenotype relevance, intervention direction and falsifiable predictions. Model healthy-tissue rescue and tumor control separately. No drug has a reserved lead position and no composite efficacy probability is assigned.
discovery_policy: Select and test molecular interventions before selecting drugs. Use literature to specify and challenge mechanistic relationships, public experiments to fit and test models, and broad drug-target activity data to identify compounds. Prior drug screens remain supporting evidence.
next_stage: Calibrate the variant-mechanism and PP2A-B56/Aurora B models with public functional measurements, then acquire quantitative drug-target activities and evaluate explicit exposure scenarios in separate healthy-tissue and tumor arms.
